name: Guru
description: Trusted Cards, Collections, Knowledge Agents, connected sources, verification workflows, and organization knowledge through Guru OAuth.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Relay-owned Guru OAuth, then let agents search trusted knowledge, ask verified questions, create drafts, suggest updates, and use the complete delegated API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

capabilities.label: Read trusted knowledge
capabilities.description: Read teams, search Cards and connected sources, list Knowledge Agents, and ask verified questions.

capabilities.label: Create and update knowledge
capabilities.description: Create Card drafts, suggest Card updates, upload supported content, and use the complete delegated Guru API v1 surface.

allowed.label: Search cards
allowed.description: Search a bounded page of permitted Guru Cards.

allowed.label: List Knowledge Agents
allowed.description: List permitted Guru Knowledge Agents through Guru MCP.

allowed.label: Ask Knowledge Agent
allowed.description: Ask a bounded question and receive Guru's verified, cited answer.

allowed.label: Search connected knowledge
allowed.description: Search permitted Guru Cards and connected sources through Guru MCP.

approvalRequired.label: Create card draft
approvalRequired.description: Create a Guru Card draft; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Suggest card update
approvalRequired.description: Suggest an update to an existing Guru Card; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Upload file
approvalRequired.description: Upload one bounded file to a documented Guru API endpoint; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Guru API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Guru REST API v1 operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded organization, search, and verified-answer reads run directly; creation, updates, uploads, and every other API operation require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized Guru operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, account binding, fixed origins, bounds, audits, schema validation, and provider permissions still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed REST and MCP wrappers and proxies OAuth server-side.
Railway mounts typed REST and MCP wrappers and proxies OAuth server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Guru Support must enable and approve the Relay Console OAuth client; Relay must then register the exact Railway callback and configure the issued client ID and secret.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Guru Support to enable Relay Console OAuth, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/guru/callback with default read/write scope, configure GURU_CLIENT_ID and GURU_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then run OAuth, team and MCP health, a bounded search, and an approved or Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: Guru documents confidential OAuth authorization-code clients, default read/write scope, exact redirect URIs, one-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, authorization and token endpoints, and Support enablement.
Guru's official REST API uses the fixed https://api.getguru.com/api/v1/ origin and exposes organization knowledge management.
Guru array endpoints use Link-header next-page tokens and Card search pages are bounded to 50 results.
Guru's official MCP exposes list Knowledge Agents, ask, search, create draft, and update Card capabilities.
Guru recommends OAuth for user-facing AI integrations and enforces existing RBAC and Agent Center logging.
Guru's fixed Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint is https://mcp.api.getguru.com/mcp and supports OAuth custom clients.
